integrity: The proof analytically treats all angles and all admissible widths; finite randomized clipping checks are additional corroboration, not a substitute for the proof. The external planar single-plank theorem is used with attribution.
scientific_limitations: For regular Euclidean hexagons and finite plank families only. Uniqueness is for the single centered plank normal modulo dihedral symmetry; not a classification of all optimal multi-plank configurations. Earlier unindexed strip-direction computations may exist.
title: Sharp four-regime partial-plank profile of the regular hexagon
